title: 6 · CAD loop: edit, re-import, rerun
summary: The workflow for your own dies: export three bodies from CAD, simulate, change the CAD, re-import with every setting kept.
instructions: 1. In your CAD system put the bottom die, workpiece and top die in one part or assembly, in press position (dies apart, workpiece between them), and export STEP (AP214 or AP242).
2. Import STEP… and pick the top die (the one that moves down). The workpiece is the body in the middle; Z-up and Y-up models both work.
3. Set the material and temperature, press Solve, then Save setup… so the job can be reopened later.

4. Change the dies or the billet in CAD and export to the same file. A yellow 'STEP file changed' banner appears: press Re-import & solve (or Shift+click Re-import). The top die, material, mesh and press settings are kept.
5. Every run stays in RUNS with its own colour, so you can compare design iterations directly on the load / fill chart.
This demo opens the gear-blank sample; replace it with your own file.
